summary_1line: Abhimanyu duels Jayadratha and repels surrounding kings before Bhima steps in to fight Salya in a fierce mace battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: Abhimanyu leaps up and catches Salya's blazing iron dart in midair like Garuda seizing a falling serpent.
Abhimanyu and Jayadratha clash on the ground with sword and shield, circling like a tiger and a lion amid watching armies.
Bhima and Salya whirl massive maces in a roaring duel, sparks flying as the weapons collide while warriors watch from all sides.
